description.zh: 装完 DSH 后第一件事：看懂上下文、管技能、找回归档会话、回退对话、随手旁问。全是界面与会话增强，不额外占用模型上下文。
description.en: The first things to add after installing DSH: context insight, skill management, archived sessions, in-place rewind and side questions. UI and session helpers that add no tool definitions to the model's context.

why.zh: 在设置里管理本地技能
按工作区搜索、恢复已归档会话
why.en: Search and restore archived sessions by workspace

why.zh: 在同一会话里原地回退对话

why.en: /btw side questions that stay out of the main thread
